test_case_name: Accept Cookies on Parent and Child Pages

intents.intent: Click 'Acconsento' on the parent page to accept all cookies.
Click 'Corporate' link on the parent page to navigate to the child page.
Click 'ACCONSENTO' on the child page to accept all cookies.
And then check that cookies are accepted on both the parent and child pages.

test_case_name: Reject Cookies via More Options on Parent and Child Pages

intents.intent: Click 'Più opzioni' link on the parent page to access cookie options.
Click 'Corporate' link on the parent page to navigate to the child page.
Click 'PIÙ OPZIONI' link on the child page to access more cookie options.
And then check that the cookie options page is displayed on the child page.

test_case_name: Close Cookie Banner on Parent and Child Pages

intents.intent: Click button with id 'cookie-chiudi' on the parent page to close the cookie banner.
Click 'Corporate' link on the parent page to navigate to the child page.
Click button with id 'js-cookie-banner-close' on the child page to close the cookie banner.
And then check that the cookie banners are closed on both the parent and child pages.

test_case_name: Use Accessibility Skip Links on Parent and Child Pages

intents.intent: Click 'Passa al Contenuto' button on the parent page to skip to main content.
Click 'Corporate' link on the parent page to navigate to the child page.
Click 'Passa al Contenuto' button on the child page to skip to main content.
And then check that the focus is moved to the main content on the child page.

test_case_name: Perform Search on Parent and Child Pages

intents.intent: Type $name into the 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' search input on the parent page.
Click button with class 'btn-search' to submit the search on the parent page.
Click 'Corporate' link on the parent page to navigate to the child page.
Click button with class 'header-navbar-btn-search' on the child page to open the search input.
Type $name into the 'Cerca' search input on the child page.
Click button with class 'btn-search' to submit the search on the child page.
And then check that the search results are displayed on the child page.

test_case_name: Download Presentation from Child Page via Parent Navigation

intents.intent: Click 'Corporate' link on the parent page to navigate to the child page.
Click 'SCARICA LA PRESENTAZIONE' link on the child page to download the presentation.
And then check that the presentation PDF is downloaded successfully.

test_case_name: Access Investor Relations Results from Child Page via Parent Navigation

intents.intent: Click 'Corporate' link on the parent page to navigate to the child page.
Click 'Risultati 1sem.25' link on the child page to view investor relations results.
And then check that the investor relations results page is displayed.

test_case_name: Access Shareholders’ Meeting Information from Child Page via Parent Navigation

intents.intent: Click 'Corporate' link on the parent page to navigate to the child page.
Click 'Assemblea degli Azionisti' link on the child page to view shareholders’ meeting information.
And then check that the shareholders’ meeting information page is displayed.

test_case_name: Access Statute Document from Child Page via Parent Navigation

intents.intent: Click 'Corporate' link on the parent page to navigate to the child page.
Click 'Statuto al 30 ottobre 2024' link on the child page to view the statute document.
And then check that the statute PDF is downloaded or displayed.

Click 'Piano di Impresa 2022-2025' link on the child page to view the business plan document.
